item.description: Chief Mike Krantz of the Bend Police Department in Oregon said four victims were killed, including three children and a teacher, in a school shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School. Krantz added that the 16-year-old suspect is also dead.

item.description: Authorities said the 16-year-old shooter forced entry into the school by shooting at locked doors using a long gun. NBC News' Tom Winter discusses the damage a long gun is capable of, the heroism of a community member to pursue the suspect and the misinformation that accumulates after a mass shooting.
